STEP 2. Check the windshield wiper and washer switch.
Q: Is the windshield wiper and washer switch in good 
condition?
YES : Go to Step 3.
NO : Replace it. The input signal from the column switch 
(windshield wiper and washer switch) should be able 
to be checked and the windshield wiper and washer 
should work normally.
STEP 3. Replacement of ECU
(1) Replace the column switch (turn-signal light and lighting 
switch).
(2) The input signal from the column switch (windshield wiper 
and washer switch) should be able to be checked and the 
windshield wiper and washer should work normally.
Q: Is the input signal from the column switch (windshield 
wiper and washer switch) input normally?
YES : There is no action to be taken.
NO : Replace the ETACS-ECU. The input signal from the 
column switch (windshield wiper and washer switch) 
should be able to be checked and the windshield 
wiper and washer should work normally.
